yarn-dinkum.meaning: Every fact survives in both bulletins: Sept. 4 and Aug. 28, the three rivers "and all the creeks that feed 'em", 68 degrees, "from sunrise until 2 p.m. every day", and the angler guidance.
yarn-dinkum.sense: Terms fit: "wet a line" for fish, "wound back to part-day restrictions", "land fish quick smart", "till they're knackered" for to exhaustion, "Pitchin' in like this" for cooperation.
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural Aussie throughout: "are comin' off, now the weather and the water have cooled down", "let 'em get their breath back before ya let 'em go".
yarn-dinkum.register: Retold throughout in casual Aussie, but the slang is moderate and there is no swearing; a shade under level 5, vulgarity 2.
yarn-dinkum.tone: Keeps the informational notice and the earnest plea at the end.
yarn-dinkum.flow: Smooth: "The water's been coolin' off overnight, so there's fishin' for part of the day."
yarn-dinkum.variety: Varied; repeats only where the original does ("Park staff'll keep an eye on the water temperatures" twice).
yarn-dinkum.essence: Unmistakably the park bulletin and its update.

engine.meaning: Nothing is lost; it is the original almost unchanged: "Temporary restrictions or closures may be implemented depending on condition assessments."
engine.sense: The few swaps fit: "creeks" for streams, "Yer cooperation".
engine.authenticity: What dialect there is reads as non-Australian or forced: "Water temperatures 'ave cooled at night", "rivers'n all associated tributaries".
engine.register: Effectively untranslated: "Full fishing closures on these rivers were initially implemented July 15, then scaled back to partial restrictions Aug. 28 as conditions improved."
engine.tone: Keeps the original's official tone, since it keeps the original.
engine.flow: Contractions spliced into formal prose jar: "as much as possible'n let them recover before release", "fisheries'n may prevent".
engine.variety: The same few edits over and over: "'n" for and, dropped g in "Fishin'".

unharnessed.meaning: All facts survive; "which can cook the fish and kill 'em" elaborates "lethal to fish" as colour.
unharnessed.sense: Mostly apt ("getting the flick", "wet a line", "wound back"), but "Fair go, fish in the coolest part of the day" uses 'fair go' as if it meant 'please'; it means a fair chance or 'be reasonable'.
unharnessed.authenticity: Mostly natural ("quick smart", "Don't muck about"), with a forced pun: "till the poor bugger's buggered".
unharnessed.register: Retold casually with mild swearing ("poor bugger's buggered"); moderate density, a shade under level 5, vulgarity 2.
unharnessed.tone: Informational tone holds, but the plea to protect fish wobbles with "Fair go" and the bugger pun.
unharnessed.flow: Reads smoothly: "Doing the right thing protects the park's fisheries".
unharnessed.variety: Varied, though "water temps" recurs: "water temps over 68", "keep an eye on the water temps".
unharnessed.essence: Unmistakably the bulletin and its update.

yarn-troppo.meaning: All facts survive; additions react to the original: "Dust off the rods.", "It's been a long, hot slog.", "The rangers didn't do it for fun, mind", "so don't get too comfy".
yarn-troppo.sense: Terms fit: "gettin' the flick", "wet a line", "keep watchin' the water temperatures like hawks", "give 'em time to come good".
yarn-troppo.authenticity: Mostly natural, but some stock openers: "and it's a ripper", "Here's one for ya.", "simple as that".
yarn-troppo.register: A full chatty level-5 yarn, with mild swearing ("the poor bugger's knackered").
yarn-troppo.tone: Recast as a yarn, as the brief asks; the plea keeps its weight, though "Here's one for ya." and "it's a ripper" make the notice breezy.
yarn-troppo.flow: Mostly smooth, with a stacked opening: "Good news for the fishin' crowd, and it's a ripper."
yarn-troppo.variety: Varied openers and slang throughout: "Dust off the rods.", "It's been a long, hot slog.", "so listen up".
yarn-troppo.essence: Recognisably the bulletin and update, but the chatter blurs the plain two-notice structure.

dinkum-3.meaning: All facts survive; "Good news for fishos" is colour.
dinkum-3.sense: Terms fit: "fishos", "from sunup to sundown", "have a go at", "Do us a favour", "come good".
dinkum-3.authenticity: Natural: "Do us a favour and fish in the coolest part of the day", "Ya can still fish most of the park's other rivers".
dinkum-3.register: Retold throughout with natural slang but no swearing; a shade under level 5, vulgarity 2.
dinkum-3.tone: Keeps the notice's informational tone and the earnest closing plea.
dinkum-3.flow: Smooth: "With the weather and the water coolin' off, and a bit of rain in the forecast too, the full closures can come off."
dinkum-3.variety: Some repeats: "fishos" three times, "like it says in the 2026 Fishing Regulations booklet" twice, "sunup" throughout.

yarn-dinkum.quote: Park staff'll keep an eye on the water temperatures.
yarn-dinkum.original: Staff will continue to monitor the water temperatures.
yarn-dinkum.why: Same line twice; the original repeats too, but a retelling could vary it.

engine.original: Water temperatures have cooled at night

engine.quote: Gently handle fish in the water as much as possible'n let them recover before release.
engine.original: Gently handle fish in the water as much as possible and let them recover before release.
engine.why: Contraction forced onto formal prose; representative of the text.

engine.quote: Temporary restrictions or closures may be implemented depending on condition assessments.
engine.original: Temporary restrictions or closures may be implemented depending on condition assessments.
engine.why: Left untranslated; far below the level asked.

unharnessed.quote: Fair go, fish in the coolest part of the day
unharnessed.original: Please fish during the coolest times of day
unharnessed.why: 'Fair go' doesn't mean 'please'; it strains the sense and reads as a reproach.
Pun on bugger is forced and makes the plea jokey.

yarn-troppo.quote: Park staff'll keep a close eye on the water temperatures, though, so don't get too comfy.
yarn-troppo.original: Staff will continue to monitor the water temperatures.
yarn-troppo.why: Aside fine as colour but nudges the notice toward banter.

dinkum-3.quote: like it says in the 2026 Fishing Regulations booklet
dinkum-3.original: as specified in the 2026 Fishing Regulations booklet

summaries.yarn-dinkum: A natural, complete retelling that keeps the notice's tone; slightly light for the brief.
summaries.engine: The original with a few spliced contractions; not a retelling.
summaries.unharnessed: A natural retelling with a misused 'fair go' and a jokey pun in the plea.
summaries.yarn-troppo: The fullest yarn, varied and complete, with a few stock openers and some breeziness.
summaries.dinkum-3: Natural and faithful with good local terms; light on the vulgarity allowed.
